03 / DELIVERY PROCESS

Five transparent engineering stages from discovery brief to production handover.

Inspect full workflow →
  1. 01
    STAGE 01

    Discovery & Problem Framing

    Mapping business objectives, real-world user constraints, connectivity profiles, and technical risks before visual or code execution.

    Stage Deliverables
    • — Scoped Mini-PRD Specification
    • — Technical Risk & Constraint Log
    • — Milestone & Release Schedule
    Client Input Required

    Domain stakeholder interview, sample payloads or hardware specs, and core feature priority.

  2. 02
    STAGE 02

    Architecture & Product Design

    Locking system topology, database/API contracts, wireframes, and UI tokens so engineering progresses without costly rework.

    Stage Deliverables
    • — Architecture Topology & Data Contracts
    • — Interactive Figma Flow & Prototype
    • — Explicit Stack Trade-Off Log
    Client Input Required

    Sign-off on user workflows and core screen layouts prior to engineering sprint.

  3. 03
    STAGE 03

    Iterative Engineering

    Incremental modular implementation with regular staging previews, strict static checks, and end-to-end integration validation.

    Stage Deliverables
    • — Structured Repository Commits
    • — Periodic Staging Previews
    • — Weekly Progress Changelog
    Client Input Required

    Focused feedback per staging drop within 48 hours to keep delivery cadence tight.

  4. 04
    STAGE 04

    Verification & Production Ship

    Performance profiling, accessibility verification, environment hardening, and controlled production deployment or APK/AAB release.

    Stage Deliverables
    • — Live Production Deploy / Signed APK
    • — Deployment & Environment Playbook
    • — Operational Walkthrough Video
    Client Input Required

    Production server/domain/Play Console access and final User Acceptance Testing.

  5. 05
    STAGE 05

    Handover & Long-Term Support

    Clean ownership handover of source code and design files so client teams stay independent, backed by a post-launch stabilization window.

    Stage Deliverables
    • — Full Source & Figma Ownership Transfer
    • — Post-Launch Stabilization Coverage
    • — Optional Evolution Retainer
    Client Input Required

    Confirmation of repository owner accounts and scheduling for admin handover session.
